$comment: One view folder = one lazy bundle (dist/views/cards.js). The media grid is this view with `lightbox: true` (docs/VIEWS.md: 'Not a new view: the cards view plus a lightbox'), so it registers no type of its own and `covers` its docs/VIEWS.md row by name.

views.name: Cards
